spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact §4.1 surface ('connectionAllowlist' in HTMLIFrameElement.prototype plus both reflection directions), the §4.2 Sec-Required-Connection-Allowlist request header via a genuinely framed same-origin navigation, and the forbidden-header rule with a real fetch.

interactive.rationale: Re-probe button, frame reload button, and a forge-attempt button that fetches the echo route and prints the Sec- headers the server really received.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the IDL probe, reflection, live header echo, and the forbidden-prefix proof; all four are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles the enforcing-browser case where the non-opted-in echo frame may genuinely be blocked (5s no-report timeout labelled as possible real enforcement), and the attribute-set-but-inert baseline.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5657801797009408, spec §4, and the Fetch forbidden-request-header definition.

conformance.rationale: Mirrors the suite's IDL/reflection/forbidden-header script assertions and is the named observation route for the requirement-forwarded manual assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable here): IDL probe reported supported=false honestly; the framed echo page loaded and its server genuinely received no Sec-Required-Connection-Allowlist; the forge attempt showed the header stripped locally and absent server-side while listing the browser's own Sec-Fetch-* metadata; zero console errors/page errors, 0px overflow at 1280×800 and 360×740; screenshots captured.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts ca-embedded-idl-probed, ca-embedded-echo-reported/no-report, and ca-embedded-forge-stripped on their real branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (including the server-rendered echo page, which links the shared stylesheet); buttons pair background and color; emerald-dark/rose on light surfaces.

accessibility.rationale: Titled iframe, aria-live verdicts, captioned table with row/column scope, keyboard-focusable scroll region, focus-visible outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes driven headlessly: 0px horizontal overflow, full-width iframe, 44px buttons.

openQuestions.title: Verify the echo and blocked-frame paths on a flagged build
openQuestions.detail: On a Chromium build with ConnectionAllowlistEmbeddedEnforcement (--enable-experimental-web-platform-features), confirm the echo frame's server receives the real Sec-Required-Connection-Allowlist and that the non-opted-in echo frame is blocked (the page's timeout branch labels this). No released build carries the flag today, so only the baseline branches could be exercised.

guidanceConsulted.query: embed third party iframe security permissions exfiltration
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Treat embedder-imposed policy as consent-based and verify header behaviour server-side rather than trusting client claims.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The probe's ground truth is the server-side echo of received request headers, not any client-side inference.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates live region aria-live announce result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous outcomes via live regions and label embedded frames.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Echo and forge outcomes land in aria-live polite regions; the iframe carries a descriptive title.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long monospace strings and keep frames fluid.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: overflow-wrap:anywhere on verdicts/outputs, width:100% iframe; 0px overflow measured at 360px.

summary: Three-layer probe of the embedder-side surface: exact IDL and reflection, a genuinely framed navigation whose server reports whether the requirement header arrived, and a real forbidden-header forge attempt. Verified honestly on Chromium 141 (unsupported baseline) at both viewport classes with clean console.
